How long do your drinks effect you?

How often do you drink?

More than I'd prefer but less than I'd like. Depends on the month really.

Sometimes I'll drink like described above a few nights a week, sometimes I won't drink for a month or two. Just depends on the ebb and flow of my attitude.

Yeah if you drink like that more than 1x a week, that will be your effects, even worse if you do it back to back, as your body needs time to reset or else you build a tolerance very quickly. Wednesday and Saturday worked well for me for a long time.
